2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 29.08.1991 and 17.07.1997.

The Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences)/
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Fatehpur vide order dated 29.08.1991 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
